skill.name: tailwind-v4-shadcn
skill.description: Set up Tailwind CSS v4 with shadcn/ui in Vite React projects. The skill provides CSS variable architecture, @theme mapping, dark mode templates, migration guidance, and troubleshooting for common v4 errors.
skill.summary: Guide Vite React projects through Tailwind v4 and shadcn/ui setup with tested templates and migration fixes.
skill.author: jezweb

security_audit.summary: Static analysis flagged many patterns, but review found documentation snippets, setup examples, source links, and normal configuration values. No prompt injection, malware intent, credential access, or data exfiltration behavior was found. The remaining operational risk is ordinary package installation and file changes when a user applies the setup guidance.

remediation.issue: Markdown examples trigger command-execution and dynamic-require scanners.
remediation.suggestion: Label command snippets as user-confirmed examples and keep avoidance examples clearly marked as incorrect patterns.

remediation.issue: Setup guidance includes package installs and removal of a legacy Tailwind config file.
remediation.suggestion: Tell agents to review existing project files and ask for confirmation before running package-manager commands or deleting files.

remediation.issue: README references a hidden ~/.claude skill path for installation context.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that the path is informational and should not be accessed or modified without user approval.

content.user_title: Set Up Tailwind v4 with shadcn/ui
content.value_statement: Tailwind v4 and shadcn/ui setup can fail because v4 changes config, plugins, and theme handling. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through tested templates and troubleshooting steps.
actual_capabilities: Provides a Tailwind v4 setup sequence for Vite React and shadcn/ui projects.
Supplies templates for CSS, shadcn config, Vite config, ThemeProvider, TypeScript aliases, and cn utility.
Explains @theme inline mapping, CSS variables, base styles, and automatic dark mode behavior.
Documents migration fixes for Tailwind v3 config, plugins, @apply changes, and PostCSS issues.
Troubleshoots common color, animation, utility, and theme switching failures.
limitations: Focused on Vite React projects, not Next.js or non-React frameworks.
Provides guidance and templates, but does not validate every project automatically.
Requires package manager commands and project file changes when applied.
Version guidance should be reviewed when Tailwind or shadcn/ui release new changes.

use_cases.title: Start a Vite React UI
use_cases.description: Create a new Vite React project with Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, path aliases, and dark mode support.

use_cases.title: Fix Theme Problems
use_cases.description: Resolve broken bg-primary utilities, duplicate base layers, dark mode failures, and animation import errors.

use_cases.title: Migrate from Tailwind v3
use_cases.description: Move theme settings from config files into CSS variables and update plugins for Tailwind v4.

prompt_templates.title: Create a New Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new Vite React app.
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up Tailwind v4 with shadcn/ui in my Vite React project. Use the skill templates and explain each file change before applying it.

prompt_templates.title: Add to Existing Project
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate setup for an existing repository.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my existing Vite React project and add Tailwind v4 with shadcn/ui. Preserve current app code and list any conflicting files first.

prompt_templates.title: Debug Theme Failures
prompt_templates.scenario: Troubleshooting colors, utilities, or dark mode.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Tailwind v4 shadcn guidance to diagnose why my semantic colors or dark mode are not working. Show the likely cause and a fix plan.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a v3 Migration
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced migration from Tailwind v3 to v4.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my Tailwind v3 setup and create a migration plan for Tailwind v4 and shadcn/ui. Include risks, file changes, and verification steps.

output_examples.input: Set up Tailwind v4 and shadcn/ui in a fresh Vite React project.
output: A setup checklist with package installs, Vite plugin configuration, shadcn config updates, and file templates.
A note to confirm package manager commands before execution.
Verification steps for semantic colors and dark mode.

output_examples.input: bg-primary does not apply styles after upgrading to Tailwind v4.
output: Diagnosis that semantic utilities are missing because theme variables were not mapped.
Recommended CSS variable and @theme mapping changes.
A follow-up check for duplicate hsl wrapping and misplaced base layers.

output_examples.input: Migrate a Tailwind v3 app that uses config-based colors and animation plugins.
output: A migration sequence that removes legacy config use, updates plugins, and moves theme tokens into CSS.
A risk list for visual regressions, PostCSS conflicts, and @apply usage.
A test plan covering light mode, dark mode, and shadcn components.

best_practices: Confirm the framework, package manager, and Tailwind version before applying setup steps.
Compare templates against existing files before replacing project configuration.
Test a shadcn component, semantic colors, and light or dark theme switching after changes.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill unchanged for Tailwind v3, Next.js, or non-React projects.
Do not delete existing Tailwind config before checking for project-specific theme customizations.
Do not mix PostCSS setup and the Vite plugin unless the project requires both.

faq.question: What stack does this skill support?
faq.answer: It targets Vite React projects that use Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui.

faq.question: Does it include dark mode support?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a ThemeProvider pattern with light, dark, and system theme options.

faq.question: Can I use it with Next.js?
faq.answer: Not directly. The guidance is Vite-focused and should be adapted for Next.js.

faq.question: What templates are included?
faq.answer: It includes CSS, shadcn config, Vite config, ThemeProvider, TypeScript alias, and utility templates.

faq.question: Does the skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides setup commands and should ask for confirmation before package installs or file changes.

faq.question: What should I review before using it?
faq.answer: Review package installs, file replacements, existing theme customizations, and project-specific migration needs.
